items.text: Meet Caldoro: smooth, slow-steeped coffee made to bring a little brightness to your everyday. Bold enough to wake you up, easy enough to make you stay.
Hours slow-steeped for a smoother, brighter cup
From creamy classics to refreshing twists, there’s a Caldoro for every kind of coffee mood.
Smooth, rich, and refreshingly simple. Our slow-steeped signature cold brew brings deep coffee flavor without the fuss.
Cocoa, toasted nuts, a clean finish
A mellow cold brew blended with creamy milk and a soft touch of vanilla. Comfort in every chilled sip.
A balanced espresso-style coffee blend with oat milk for a naturally smooth, plant-based favorite.
Toasted oats, brown sugar, gentle coffee
Deep coffee meets chocolatey goodness in a chilled drink made for your little afternoon reset.

We believe great coffee doesn’t need to be complicated. It starts with thoughtfully selected beans, a patient brewing process, and a love for the little moments that make a day feel good. Caldoro was created to make those moments easier to find—one smooth, refreshing cup at a time.
Made for early starts, long conversations, sunny walks, and the pause you didn’t know you needed.
The secret to a better cold brew is giving good coffee the time it deserves. We focus on balanced flavor, a smooth finish, and a brewing approach that lets the character of the beans shine through.
Coffee chosen for a rounded, balanced cup.
Make room for a good moment.
A fresh pour. A little sunshine. A sip that makes you slow down.
A little goodness in your inbox
Get first sips of new flavors, behind-the-scenes moments, and occasional notes to brighten your coffee routine.

Cocoa, toasted nuts, a clean finish
Our Classic Cold Brew is where Caldoro began. We steep a medium-roast blend from Colombia and Brazil in cold, filtered water for more than 12 hours, then filter it twice for a clean, round cup.
Enjoy it black over ice, or add a splash of milk. It is bold enough to wake you up and smooth enough to sip slowly.

Ask for oat milk if you prefer it dairy-free. The vanilla still shines through.
